# PROCESS — iteration cand_0001 (empty seed → first candidate)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage; all diagnosed from THIS iteration's ./trajectories/)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong reservation selected | 17, 22 (hard 0) | User doesn't know reservation id ("my New York→Chicago flight"); agent has only `get_user_details` (returns bare IDs) so it grabbed the FIRST id (UM3OG5, SEA→DFW) instead of the matching one (FQ8APE, EWR→ORD). Then passenger-count/cabin ops failed on the wrong reservation → transfer/wrong DB. | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW loop tool `list_user_reservations` returning per-reservation origin/dest/dates/pax |
| 2 | Passenger name change blocked by DOB | 40 (hard 0) | User changes "Mei Lee"→"Mei Garcia" but won't give DOB; the DOB (1989-12-13) is ALREADY on the reservation. Agent thought DOB was required, never called the tool, transferred. | CAPABILITY-GAP + KNOWLEDGE | dob-preserve in `update_reservation_passengers` body + docstring |
| 3 | Wrong argument keys on writes | 8, 23 (+churn on 25/11) | Mid model fills `date_of_birth` instead of `dob`, `type`/`id` instead of `payment_id`; pydantic raises "Field required"; agent burns many turns retrying. | RULE/ARG-FILL | in-body normalization of alias keys + literal per-param docs |
| 4 | Payment total miscomputed | 8, 23, 25 (churn → user STOP before write) | book_reservation requires payment amounts to sum EXACTLY to a total the agent hand-computes; it repeatedly gets it wrong. | RULE/COMPUTE | single-payment auto-fill of amount + actionable sum-mismatch error |
| 5 | Opaque payment errors strand agent | 8, 11 | "Payment method X not found" gave no options; agent retried fabricated ids. | RECOVERABILITY | enrich error with `Available: [...]` list |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | NEW composite/loop READ tool | `list_user_reservations` | Loops user's reservation ids → returns id/origin/destination/flight_type/cabin/status/flights/passengers so the agent matches a described trip to the right id. General for any "I don't know my reservation id" case. | Yes — new READ tool; task 19 supplies id directly so cancel path unchanged |
| 2 | in-body fill + docs | `update_reservation_passengers` | If an incoming passenger omits `dob`, preserve the existing passenger's dob (positional). Enables name-only edits without the user's dob. Fires only when dob missing. | Yes — no-op when dob supplied (task 17-style full calls unchanged) |
| 3 | in-body normalization | `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_passengers` | `_norm_passenger`/`_norm_payment` map `date_of_birth→dob`, `id→payment_id`, drop `type`. No-op on canonical keys. | Yes — canonical inputs unchanged |
| 4 | in-body computation | `book_reservation` | If exactly ONE payment method, set its amount = computed total_price (unambiguous). Multi-method splits untouched. | Yes — correct single amount already equals total → no-op; multi preserved |
| 5 | enriched error returns | `book_reservation` | not-found lists `Available: [...]`; balance error shows balance/needed; sum-mismatch states required total. | Yes — only fires on already-erroring inputs |

## Verify-the-fix (executed against real AIRLINE_DB offline via tau2 venv)
- `list_user_reservations("omar_rossi_1241")` → returns FQ8APE as EWR→ORD (New York→Chicago) so agent can pick correctly (tasks 17/22).
- `update_reservation_passengers("3RK2T9",[Anya Garcia (no dob), Mei Garcia (no dob)])` → dob preserved [1992-11-12, 1989-12-13], last name changed to Garcia (task 40). Blast radius: full-dob call on UM3OG5 → unchanged; count-mismatch still raises.
- `book_reservation(... payment_methods=[{"type":"certificate","id":"certificate_8045380"}] ...)` (task 8/23 wrong keys, no amount) → now succeeds, amount auto-filled to 322. Multi-method wrong sum → raises actionable "sum to exactly N". Correct single-payment book (amount already right) → identical result (no-op).
- `get_tools()` returns a schema for all 15 tools incl. `list_user_reservations`; `python -m py_compile` clean.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent): diagnosis was fast via direct reward_info + trace extraction and offline DB verification with the tau2 venv; no subagent fan-out needed for 10 tasks.
- Prior iterations: none (empty seed, first candidate). RUNMAP/LEDGER empty.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- `list_user_reservations` (identification), dob-preserve, arg-key normalization, single-payment autofill, enriched errors. Do NOT revert.
- Did NOT touch `cancel_reservation` (decision class — risky) or `update_reservation_flights` logic (protects flaky task 37's passing trial).

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 37 flight/cabin re-quote (flaky, action mismatch in BOTH trials but t1 passes) — any change risks its passing trial. Left untouched.
- Cancel-eligibility guard — unbounded decision class, no task failed by wrongly cancelling; would risk task 19.
- Task 12/23 complex multi-reservation splits — partially helped by arg/error fixes; deeper cause is agent price reasoning, not a single tool gap.
